questions: Should the histogram bars be ordered by frequency (descending) or by string (e.g., alphabetical)?
What should happen if there are fewer than 30 unique strings generated (e.g., n_rows=5)?
Is the random string generation with replacement (i.e., can the same string appear multiple times in the generation process)?
Should the x-axis labels (strings) be displayed fully, or truncated if long? (They are always 3 letters, so not applicable.)
Is the random seed expected to be set or controlled within the function for reproducibility?
Should the histogram include a count for strings with frequency zero to make exactly 30 bars?

Should the y-axis represent absolute counts or normalized frequencies (probabilities)?
